description: Change settings of existing shape items: group Transform and Blend Mode; rectangle, ellipse, polystar and path geometry and Reverse Path Direction; fill and stroke colour, opacity, Stroke Width, Line Cap, Line Join, Dashes, Taper, Wave, Fill Rule and Composite; gradient type, Start and End Point and Highlight; and the path operations' settings (Merge Paths Mode, Repeater copies, offset and composite, Trim Multiple Shapes, Offset Paths copies, Zig Zag points, Wiggle Paths correlation, ...). Each option must apply to every item named

amount.description: Offset Paths: Amount (pixels); Pucker & Bloat: Amount (percent); Wiggle Paths, Zig Zag: Size (pixels)

blendMode.description: Group, fill, stroke, gradients: Blend Mode, as numbered in its menu (1 = Normal)

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

composite.description: Fill, stroke, gradients: Composite (below or above previous in same group); repeater: copies stack below or above

correlation.description: Wiggle Paths, Wiggle Transform: Correlation, percent

dashOffset.description: Stroke, gradient stroke: dash Offset, pixels

dashes.description: Stroke, gradient stroke: Dashes as [dash, gap, dash, gap, dash, gap], up to three pairs

detail.description: Wiggle Paths: Detail; Zig Zag: Ridges per segment

enabled.description: Turn the items on or off (eye switch)

group.description: The group to work in: names or 1-based indexes of nested groups from the layer's Contents, e.g. ["Shape 1"]. Omit for Contents itself

items.description: Items in the group, by name or 1-based index

layers.description: Which shape layers: indexes (1-based), names, or selected: true

lineJoin.description: Stroke, gradient stroke, offset paths: Line Join

miterLimit.description: Stroke, gradient stroke, offset paths: Miter Limit

opacity.description: Group: Transform Opacity; fill, stroke, gradients: Opacity, percent

path.description: Path: { vertices: [[x, y], ...], inTangents, outTangents (relative to each vertex), closed (default true) }

position.description: Rectangle, ellipse, polystar: centre; group, repeater: Transform Position

properties.description: Any other property of the item by match name or name (a nested one as "Group > Property"), to a number, array, text or true/false

randomSeed.description: Wiggle Paths, Wiggle Transform: Random Seed

reversed.description: Rectangle, ellipse, polystar, path: Reverse Path Direction

rotation.description: Polystar: rotation; group, repeater: Transform Rotation, degrees

scale.description: Group, repeater: Transform Scale [x, y] percent

spatialPhase.description: Wiggle Paths, Wiggle Transform: Spatial Phase, degrees

temporalPhase.description: Wiggle Paths, Wiggle Transform: Temporal Phase, degrees

time.description: Seconds: set keyframes at this time. Default: static values, or keyframes at the current time on animated properties

width.description: Stroke, gradient stroke: Stroke Width, pixels

name: set_shape_content
title: Set Shape Content
